title: stagesofai
blurb: paste a viral AI take (a bsky post link or the text) and it files the poster under a stage of grief: shock, denial, anger, bargaining, depression, testing, or acceptance. one tap opens a quote-post with the verdict. you press the button, so it never replies on its own. @moultano.bsky.social asked for a lil guy that does this.
